method.broad_family_selection: Recomputed from inventory.json: current user_facing=true and more than six POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE routes.
method.normalized_route_resource_rule: Take URI segments through the first parameter; for an all-literal URI longer than two segments, remove a terminal action suffix such as submit, approve, complete, retry, export, or create.
method.alias_rule: Equivalent clients/operations aliases and nested attachment or evidence mechanics are not separate capabilities unless actor, terminal entry, completion, or handoff differs.
method.route_partition_rule: Every route in each of the 70 current broad families is assigned to exactly one proposed capability.
method.page_rule: Every mapped page remains in the family page catalog. Capability page references are semantic filename matches where possible; otherwise the exact current-family page bundle is retained as a shared-surface gap.
method.evidence_boundary: All semantics are static source inference at the pinned commit. No representative actor, mutation, recovery, notification, accessibility, or state transition was executed.

gap_code_definitions.G-RUNTIME: No representative end-to-end execution; 0/215 proposed capabilities executed.
gap_code_definitions.G-STATE: Action names and source routing do not prove runtime guards, transitions, audit rows, or durable side effects.
gap_code_definitions.G-AUTHZ: Middleware does not prove site, ownership, parent-child, privacy, or direct-object authorization.
gap_code_definitions.G-ENTRY: Only a shared parent GET or no GET is available; exact terminal control/nav entry was not executed.
gap_code_definitions.G-PAGE: No unique filename-semantic page match; current-family shared page evidence is retained.

prior_claim_adjudication.classification_effect: Both corrections are outside the 70 broad families, so the original unaffected set falls from 473 to 471; neither changes the 70-to-215 replacement count.
